an5.162:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an5.162:1.3: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an5.162:2.1: Pañc'ime āvuso āghātapaṭivinayā, yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo.
an5.162:2.3: Idhāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro,
an5.162:2.4: evarūpe pi āvuso puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. 4.
an5.162:2.5: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhakāyasamācāro,
an5.162:2.6: evarūpe pi āvuso puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. 5.
an5.162:2.7: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ,
an5.162:2.8: evarūpe pi āvuso puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. 6.
an5.162:2.9: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācaro na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ,
an5.162:2.10: evarūpe pi āvuso puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. 7.
an5.162:2.11: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ,
an5.162:2.12: evarūpe pi āvuso puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. 8.
an5.162:3.1: Tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro. Kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo? 9.
an5.162:3.2: Seyyathā pi āvuso bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggahetvā dakkhiṇena pādena vitthāretvā, yo tattha sāro, taṃ paripācetvā ādāya pakkameyya,
an5.162:3.3: evam eva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, yāssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā, na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā, yā ca khvāssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā, sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:4.1: Tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro. Kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo? 11.
an5.162:4.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito,
an5.162:4.4: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā ubhohi hatthehi iti c'iti ca sevālapaṇakaṃ apaviyūhitvā añjalinā pivitvā pakkameyya,
an5.162:4.5: evam eva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro, yāssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā, na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā, yā ca khvāssa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā, sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:5.1: Tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ. Kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo? 13.
an5.162:5.2: Seyyathā pi āvuso parittaṃ gopade udakaṃ,
an5.162:5.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito,
an5.162:5.6: sacāhaṃ añjalinā vā pivissāmi bhājanena vā, khobhessāmi taṃ lolessāmi pi taṃ apeyyam pi taṃ karissāmi,
an5.162:5.7: yan nūnāhaṃ catukuṇḍiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyyan' ti,
an5.162:5.8: so catukuṇḍiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyya,
an5.162:5.9: evam eva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, yāssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā, na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā,
an5.162:5.10: yā pi 'ssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā, sā pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na manasikātabbā,
an5.162:5.11: yañ ca kho so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, tad ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbaṃ.
an5.162:6.1: Tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ. Kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo? 15.
an5.162:6.2: Seyyathā pi āvuso puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggapaṭipanno,
an5.162:6.3: tassa purato pi 'ssa dūre gāmo pacchato pi 'ssa dūre gāmo,
an5.162:6.4: so na labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni na labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni na labheyya paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ na labheyya gāmantanāyakaṃ,
an5.162:6.5: tam enaṃ aññataro puriso passeyya addhānamaggapaṭipanno,
an5.162:6.6: so tasmiṃ purise kāruññaṃ yeva upaṭṭhāpeyya anudayaṃ yeva upaṭṭhāpeyya anukampaṃ yeva upaṭṭhāpeyya
an5.162:6.7: ‘aho vatāyaṃ puriso labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni labheyya paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ labheyya gāmantanāyakaṃ.
an5.162:6.9: Māyaṃ puriso idh'eva anayavyasanaṃ āpajjatī' ti. Evam
an5.162:6.10: eva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, evarūpe āvuso puggale kāruññaṃ yeva upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ anudayā yeva upaṭṭhāpetabbā anukampā yeva upaṭṭhāpetabbā
an5.162:6.11: ‘aho vata ayam āyasmā kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveyya, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveyya, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveyya.
an5.162:6.13: Māyam āyasmā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatī' ti.
an5.162:7.1: Tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ. Kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo? 17.
an5.162:7.2: Seyyathā pi āvuso pokkharaṇī acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setodakā supatiṭṭhā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā,
an5.162:7.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito,
an5.162:7.4: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā tatth'eva rukkhachāyāya nisīdeyya vā nipajjeyya vā,
an5.162:8.1: evam eva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, yā pi'ssa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā, sā pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā,
an5.162:8.2: yā pi 'ssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā, sā pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā,
an5.162:8.3: yam pi so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbaṃ.
an5.162:8.5: Samantapāsādikaṃ āvuso puggalaṃ āgamma cittaṃ pasīdati.
an5.162:9.1: Ime kho āvuso pañca āghātapaṭivinayā, yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo
